selection_instructions:
OBJECT ASSORTMENT AND MECHANISM MEMORY — PLAN ONLY
Identify the principal danger and its target from the actual scene before choosing an intervention. First consider the supplied objects for a coherent, readable solution. Object names are invitations to adapt their physical properties, never prescribed answers to a problem. The assortment has no object-to-mechanism assignments. Accessories remain optional. If the assortment is unsuitable or direct hand action works more clearly, choose another object or no accessory and explain the departure in variety_choice.departure_reason. Do not add an unnecessary accessory to satisfy a list.
Available objects (stable catalog_id: canonical English name):
- zipper: zipper
- clothespin: clothespin
- sewing_needle: sewing needle
- thread_spool: spool of thread
- button: button
- safety_pin: safety pin
- shoelace: shoelace
- belt_buckle: belt buckle
- thimble: thimble
- elastic_band: elastic band
- funnel: funnel
- colander: colander
Main mechanism families, ordered from less recently used with the other fallback last, and their recent accepted Plan counts: link (Connect or join): 0; separate (Separate or cut): 0; move (Move or transport): 0; redirect (Redirect a course or flow): 0; absorb_remove (Capture, absorb or extract): 0; reshape (Deform or reshape): 0; temperature (Change temperature): 0; support (Support or stabilize): 0; contain (Confine or contain): 0; shield (Interpose a screen): 0; other (Other physical operation): 0.
Prefer a less-used mechanism when it genuinely suits the scene. These are soft preferences, not a rotation quota or mandatory family. Effectiveness, lasting benefit and readability within the requested duration take priority. Choose the family of the decisive operation that produces the benefit, not the preliminary gestures or a general goal. Explain that actual operation and its effect in help_contract.mechanism; merely changing its family label does not create variety. Use other only when none of the ten usual families accurately describes the decisive physical operation, and describe that operation concretely in help_contract.mechanism. Other is a classification fallback, never a preferred choice for novelty or a way to avoid repetition counts. Declare only the objects actually used and the principal mechanism in variety_choice. For a supplied object keep its catalog_id and canonical name; for an object outside the assortment whose ID is not supplied, use catalog_id null and its English name. Never copy the assortment or family inventory into scene actions.
